pack.title: Delivering bad news
pack.description: Give unwelcome news without hiding the next step.

scenarios.setting: You need to tell a client a promised delivery will be late.
scenarios.jab: Are we still getting this by Friday?
scenarios.goal: Give unwelcome news without hiding the next step.

replies.line: We won't meet Friday. I can confirm the revised schedule by noon.
replies.why: It states the missed commitment directly and provides a specific next update.
replies.delivery: Lead with the delay, pause for their response, then offer only a timetable you can honor.

replies.line: Friday won't work. Update by noon.
replies.why: It gives the essential news and timing without evasion.
replies.delivery: Lead with the delay, pause for their response, then offer only a timetable you can honor.

replies.line: I'm sorry; we won't meet Friday, and I'll send the revised schedule and options by noon.
replies.why: It acknowledges the impact while committing to a concrete update.
replies.delivery: Lead with the delay, pause for their response, then offer only a timetable you can honor.

followUp.line: We did, and we've missed that commitment; here's what I can do to help you plan.
followUp.why: It owns the failure before discussing mitigation rather than blaming the client for expecting delivery.
followUp.delivery: Lead with the delay, pause for their response, then offer only a timetable you can honor.
